title: Series opens: law and prophets hang on love
english: Commentariorum Series — the old Latin interpretation of Origen on Matthew. After the commands to love God and neighbor, ask how [[all the law and the prophets hang on these two commandments >> Bible:Matthew 22:40]]. Whoever has fulfilled love of God and neighbor is worthy of wisdom and a word of knowledge through the Spirit, and rejoices in the wisdom of God.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Christ knows himself as David’s seed and eternal Word
english: The Savior knew himself [[made from the seed of David according to the flesh >> Bible:Romans 1:3]], predestined Son of God in power; [[I am the way and the truth and the life >> Bible:John 14:6]]; [[before Abraham I am >> Bible:John 8:58]]; the Word that was in the beginning with God. The Pharisees knew the human dispensation from David’s seed, but not the deeper things. Glory to Christ. Amen.

added_allusions.reason: seed of David / Son in power
